body:
More on Wyvaran from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's page "Wyvaran (17 RP)" but are not part of the Wyvaran entry, which is unchanged.

Thought to be a fusion of kobolds and wyverns, wyvarans are often found leading kobold tribes, serving wyverns, or even dwelling among true dragons. Like wyverns, they are territorial creatures, but also have an acute sense of honor. Depending on how they are treated, wyvarans can become powerful allies or deadly enemies.

Racial Traits
Ability Score Modifiers: Standard (+2 Dex, –2 Int, +2 Wis) (0 RP)
Type: Dragon (10 RP)
Size: Medium (0 RP)
Base Speed: Normal (0 RP)
Languages: Standard (0 RP)

MOVEMENT RACIAL TRAITS

Fly Wyvaran have a fly speed of 30 ft. (clumsy maneuverability) (4 RP)
Natural Attacks: Slapping tail (3 RP)

Cleric: The cleric can reduce the number of level increase required to use a metamagic feat by 1/4 (to a minimum of +0). You must select this ability 4 times to reduce the level increase required by 1. [JBE:BoHR:AFCO]
Cryptic: Add +1/5 to the cryptic’s damage reduction when using the absorb altered defense. [JBE:BoHR:AFCO]
Dread: Add +1/2 to the dread’s daily uses of terrors. [JBE:BoHR:AFCO]
Druid: The druid can use her wild empathy ability to improve the attitude of dragons with a -6 penalty. Each additional time this option is selected, this penalty is reduced by 1/3 per level. [JBE:BoHR:AFCO]

Soulknife: Add +1/2 damage when the mind blade has either conductive, corrosive, flaming, or frost blade skills. [JBE:BoHR:AFCO]
Summoner: Add +1/2 to the summoner’s eidolon’s spell resistance. The eidolon must have the spell resistance evolution to benefit from this option. [JBE:BoHR:AFCO]

Tactician: Add +1/3 willing targets to the tactician’s collective. [JBE:BoHR:AFCO]
Time Thief: A time thief with the steal fate temporal talent increases the penalty given to its target by 1/6. [JBE:BoHR:AFCO]
Vitalist: Add +1/3 willing targets to the vitalist’s collective. Warpriest: Gain 1/6 of a new bonus combat feat. [JBE:BoHR:AFCO]
